name: Sunworks Solar LLC
old_description: Start your energy consumption audit today with Sunworks Solar
about:
Sunworks Solar LLC operates from Fort Wayne, Indiana. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The firm specializes in turnkey solar photovoltaic systems for homes and farms, handling custom design, installation, maintenance, and real-time production monitoring. It is certified to install Enphase microinverters, which carry a 25-year warranty, and prefers panels manufactured in Indiana. The company also offers energy consumption audits to identify savings opportunities before installation. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Its customer base includes residential homeowners seeking to lower electric bills, agricultural operations adding solar to farm buildings, and commercial clients listed under 'Independent Personal & Business.' The company promotes an energy consumption audit as a first step toward system sizing.

Sunworks Solar differentiates itself through its Enphase certification, use of domestically produced panels, and a monitoring platform that lets owners track generation and consumption in real time. It also emphasizes labor warranties and a certified, insured installation crew.
